mechanics.executable_reminder: Create a white Aura enchantment token with "Enchant creature" and "Sacrifice this token: Untap enchanted creature." attached to target creature.

rule_text.name: 701.69a
rule_text.rule: Adjudicate is a keyword action that means “Create a white Aura enchantment token with enchant creature and 'Sacrifice this token: Untap enchanted creature' and attach it to target creature.”

rule_text.name: 701.69b
rule_text.rule: If the token can't be attached to the target creature, for example if it has protection from enchantments, the token will never enter the battlefield.

rule_text.name: 701.69c
rule_text.rule: Adjudicate type is a variant of the adjudicate action. “Adjudicate [type]” means “Create a white Aura enchantment token with enchant [type] and 'Sacrifice this token: Untap enchanted permanent' and attach it to target [type] permanent.”

rule_text.name: 701.69a
rule_text.rule: Adjudicate is a keyword action that means “Create a white Aura enchantment token with enchant creature and 'Sacrifice this token: Untap enchanted creature' and attach it to target creature.”

rule_text.name: 701.69b
rule_text.rule: If the token can't be attached to the target creature, for example if it has protection from enchantments, the token will never enter the battlefield.

rule_text.name: 701.69c
rule_text.rule: Adjudicate type is a variant of the adjudicate action. “Adjudicate [type]” means “Create a white Aura enchantment token with enchant [type] and 'Sacrifice this token: Untap enchanted permanent' and attach it to target [type] permanent.”
